title: 扶正了
brief: One green-streak taupe-haired Nailü, WHITE day-battle V3 gloves, pearl headband, large ribbon beside her own hair. She notices one crooked ribbon tail, straightens it with the same gloved hand, smiles proudly, removes hand, it droops again; measured deadpan stare loops to noticing.

board.title: 扶正了
poses: 0.00 s: Draw full-body Nailü with green-streak taupe hair, pearl headband, WHITE day-battle V3 gloves, and a large ribbon beside her right temple; both hands rest at her waist as raised eyebrows reveal her noticing one crooked ribbon tail.
0.45 s: Keep her left hand at her waist; raise her right gloved hand toward the crooked tail, following its tip with her eyes.
0.95 s: Pinch the crooked tail between her right thumb and index finger; hold her head still and watch the contact.
1.45 s: Lift and rotate the pinched tail into straight alignment beneath the knot; narrow her eyes in concentration.
1.95 s: Hold the straightened tail with the same fingers; lift her chin slightly and smile proudly.
2.45 s: Release the tail and withdraw her right hand toward her chest; keep her proud smile while the tail briefly stays straight.
2.95 s: Return her right hand to her waist as the same tail bends downward; flatten her smile and track the droop with her eyes.
3.45 s: Show the tail settled into its original crooked droop; keep both hands at her waist during a still, half-lidded deadpan stare.
4.25 s: Keep the crooked tail and waist-level hands fixed; slightly open her eyelids and begin raising her eyebrows toward renewed noticing.
board.continuity: Use a fixed camera and framing throughout the 4.8-second loop, preserve all accessories and left-hand placement, use only her right hand to adjust the same tail, and ease distinct pose nine into pose one.
